description: This source file defines the DeleteInterestPauseCommandHandler class, which handles delete commands for interest pauses in the loan portfolio module of the Fineract project. It processes incoming commands to delete interest pauses based on loan identifiers.

classes.name: DeleteInterestPauseCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring component that handles delete interest pause commands, utilizing the InterestPauseWritePlatformService to perform deletion based on provided loan identifiers.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JsonCommand to delete an interest pause, identifying the loan by ID or external ID and invoking the corresponding service method.
